title: SurrealDB 1.0.0 before 4.0.0 prints SURREAL_PASS and SURREAL_TOKEN environment variable values in clear text in the…
description: SurrealDB versions from 1.0.0 up to but not including 4.0.0 expose sensitive environment variable values (SURREAL_PASS and SURREAL_TOKEN) in clear text in the CLI help output. This occurs because the CLI commands do not hide environment variable values when displaying help, potentially exposing root database credentials to anyone who can view terminal outputs such as shell logs, CI logs, or screen shares.
